L0_postulates.name: Discrete space
L0_postulates.statement: A 3D cubic lattice of voxels with undefined boundary: at every specified position, axis-adjacent sites exist; not a completed-infinity Z^3 totality -- arbitrarily large finite computations are well-posed, completed limits are not.

L0_postulates.name: Discrete time
L0_postulates.statement: Dynamics proceeds in global ticks; substrate simultaneity is absolute (a privileged foliation -- the neo-Lorentzian reading).

L0_postulates.name: Local causality
L0_postulates.statement: Updates depend only on the 26-neighbour Moore neighborhood at the previous tick; information moves at most 1 voxel per tick.

L0_postulates.name: Determinism
L0_postulates.statement: The update map is a function; determinism is not reversibility -- a deterministic map may be many-to-one.
